arguments.command:
TAG=testlog
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${TAG}"
rm -f "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" 
mkfifo "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"
nohup bash -c 'echo hi > /tmp/inner_hi_${TAG}.log; sleep 10' < "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" > "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>&1 &
sleep 1
ls -la "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" && echo OK
ps aux | grep "inner_hi_${TAG}" | grep -v grep || true
